references.text: Andreas is identified here as the brother of Simon Peter, a relationship that is central to his presentation in John 6:8.
Andreas, the brother of Simon Peter, appears again as a disciple who takes the initiative to contact Jesus, which he also does in John 6:8.
Matthew lists Andreas as the brother of Simon Peter, confirming the identity given in John 6:8.
Mark introduces Andreas as the brother of Simon, a title used to identify him in John 6:8.
